question: A thaw or just a handshake?

lines.text: Germany's foreign minister has met Russia's Sergey Lavrov, their first talks since the 2022 invasion of Ukraine.
It happened today at the UN in New York. German news agency dpa says it lasted about twenty minutes.
Moscow says the German side asked for the meeting.
lines.note: Russian MFA via The Moscow Times; Zakharova via TASS

lines.text: A German official says Johann Wadephul told Russia to abandon its dangerous path of escalation.

scene.who: Johann Wadephul, per a German official

lines.text: Germany says Russia was behind an attempted drone attack at Leipzig airport in August.
lines.note: The Moscow Times; Germany blamed Russia on 1 Sep (Guardian, BBC)

lines.text: Berlin then shut the Russian House. Moscow ordered Goethe-Institut centres closed.
lines.note: blue News (dpa); Reuters / Al Jazeera, 3 Sep

lines.text: Today's talks ended with a handshake. Then Lavrov told reporters nothing new came from them.
His last talks with a German foreign minister were in January 2022, weeks before the invasion.
So, is this a thaw, or just a handshake?

caption: Lavrov and Germany's foreign minister Johann Wadephul met at the UN today, their first talks since Russia's 2022 invasion of Ukraine. A German official says Wadephul told Moscow to abandon its dangerous path of escalation. Lavrov says nothing new came from it. A thaw or just a handshake?
